title: Collision Avoidance Robot
description: Interactive simulation for Collision Avoidance Robot
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Collision
learningObjectives: Identify the robot's four states — stopped, forward, backing up, and turning — and the events that trigger each transition
Trace the sense-decide-act loop that fires when the robot comes within 20 pixels of the boundary circle: back up 20, turn 120 degrees, resume forward
Predict the robot's path after a random left or right 120-degree turn at the boundary
Explain how the Start, Stop, and Reset buttons drive the state machine, and why Reset returns the robot to the center in the stopped state
Distinguish the robot's heading, drawn as a red front line, from its direction of travel while backing up
